Hello,
UnivEdge Consulting is hiring for one of our direct clients - a global technology consulting leader based in the US. Immediate interviews for the below position.
Role: Agentic AI Engineer - Cloud Infrastructure Automation
Location: US, Remote
Contractual (W2/C2C)
Role Summary
We are seeking an Agentic AI Engineer to design and deliver AI agents that operate against live cloud infrastructure. This is a hands-on build role: you will stand up agent workflows that interpret infrastructure state and telemetry, generate and validate Infrastructure-as-Code, and execute controlled remediation and provisioning actions under human-in-the-loop approval.
This is not a research or prototyping role. The expectation is working, governed automation deployed into a real environment within the engagement window.
Key Responsibilities
Build and deploy agentic workflows using an LLM orchestration framework (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or cloud-native equivalents such as Bedrock Agents / Azure AI Agent Service)
Design and implement tool/function-calling layers that expose infrastructure operations to agents safely — including MCP-based tooling where applicable
Generate, review and validate Terraform modules programmatically; integrate policy-as-code checks (OPA/Sentinel, tflint, checkov) into agent output paths
Integrate agents with observability and ITSM systems (DataDog, ServiceNow, PagerDuty, Jira) for alert triage and automated ticket-to-action flows
Implement guardrails: least-privilege execution roles, approval gates, dry-run/plan-only modes, audit logging of every agent action
Build evaluation and regression harnesses for agent behaviour (accuracy, tool-selection correctness, failure containment)
Wire agent workflows into existing CI/CD pipelines
Document architecture and hand over to the client's platform team at engagement close
Required Skills
Agentic AI / LLM
2+ years building production LLM applications, including at least one deployed multi-step agentic system
Strong command of one orchestration framework (LangGraph/LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel) plus tool/function calling and structured output
Practical experience with agent guardrails, retries, failure handling and human-in-the-loop approval design
RAG fundamentals: embeddings, vector stores (pgvector, OpenSearch, Pinecone), retrieval quality tuning
Agent evaluation and observability (LangSmith, Langfuse, Ragas, or equivalent custom harnesses)
Infrastructure / Platform
5+ years in cloud infrastructure, platform or DevOps engineering
Deep Terraform: module design, state and remote backends, workspaces, drift handling; Terragrunt or Terraform Cloud/Enterprise a plus
Policy-as-code: OPA/Rego, Sentinel, or equivalent
Cloud depth in at least one of AWS / Azure / OCI, including IAM and least-privilege design
CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI or Jenkins
Containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
Observability tooling - DataDog strongly preferred
Engineering
Expert-level Python (async, API integration, testing)
Secrets management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault)
Git-based workflows and code review discipline

Your first assignment
Your first assignment is to build the backend that powers how a federal agency processes its filer applications: the services and secure application programming interfaces (APIs) that move each submission through document processing, validation, and decisioning. The work is real, hard, and it matters. It is also where you start, not the shape of your career here: we hire people, not seats, and we move our best to where the hardest problems are.

Backend services and REST APIs in Python and FastAPI that turn a manual, document-heavy process into something fast, secure, and automated.
The cloud behind them on Amazon Web Services (AWS): Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, and S3, with PostgreSQL for the data and identity handled the right way.
In time, the firm itself: new capabilities, tools, and lines of business you help spin up.

You have a hacker's mindset: you would rather ship a working prototype tonight than a perfect plan next week. You have built backends and APIs that hold up in production, and you move at the speed of the tools, not the clock. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat, quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.
What you bring
Strong Python and hands-on experience building secure REST APIs (FastAPI or similar) on AWS.
The backend fundamentals behind them: PostgreSQL, authentication and access control, and clean, automated delivery.
The judgment to build in a regulated federal environment where security and auditability are not optional.
What you'll need
Sole United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination are required for this initial engagement. This is a hybrid role based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and it requires commuting into DC regularly. Everything else, the years, the certifications, the specific tools, we ask in the application and get into during the interview.
What we offer
A high-performing team of developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists solving complex, real-world problems, with work that runs from strategy formulation to hands-on implementation. We develop people across roles and clients, with extensive onboarding and sponsored training and professional development. And Peregrine has been a Benefit Corporation from day one: public value is built into the work itself, not bolted on afterward. Work worth your best years.
What we commit to
As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.
We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

description_preview:
About Coveur.ai
Coveur.ai is an AI-first startup transforming the Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance space. We help insurance carriers become dramatically more efficient by putting Claude to work across underwriting, claims, and back-office operations. Our team pairs deep insurance domain expertise with modern AI engineering to solve high-impact problems in a massive, evolving industry.
Role Overview
We’re building Claude-powered solutions for real insurance carriers, and we’re looking for candidates who want to become expert practitioners at designing and shipping them.
The opportunity begins with a one-month, supported certification sprint. Coveur will sponsor one official attempt at the Claude Certified Architect – Foundations (CCAR-F) certification and support participants through a plan, standups with other cohort members, progress milestones, peer collaboration, and exam-readiness reviews.
Participants are expected to take ownership of their preparation and independently complete the required learning between cohort sessions. The certification stage is unpaid—Coveur will sponsor the official examination fee but does not compensate study or preparation time. Participants will not perform client work, production work, or other business services for Coveur during this stage.
Candidates who successfully earn the certification will be evaluated for continuation into a paid, remote Claude Implementation Internship at approximately 40 hours per week. Continuation will be determined based on certification outcome and timing, participation and consistency throughout the sprint, demonstrated technical capability, communication, reliability, and overall fit.
Candidates selected to continue will receive hands-on experience building production AI solutions in a customer-centric environment, initially working alongside Coveur’s leadership and implementation team on insurance-carrier engagements.
What You’ll Do
During the Certification Sprint
* Complete the applicable Anthropic Partner Academy training and preparation materials.
* Participate in daily/weekly standups with other cohorts and leverage the Coveur team for support while tracking progress and preparation.
* Follow the cohort’s preparation schedule and complete the required milestones.
* Independently prepare for and earn the Claude Certified Architect – Foundations certification.
* Make your first certification attempt by approximately September 10, 2026, with a target of completing certification no later than September 25, 2026.
If Selected to Continue After Certification
* Design and build Claude-based solutions for P&C insurance carriers—automating underwriting reviews, claims triage, document processing, and data extraction.
* Participate in carrier-client discussions alongside Coveur’s leadership and implementation team to understand workflows and translate them into well-architected Claude implementations.
* Apply prompt engineering, context management, structured outputs, retrieval, and agentic patterns to production-grade use cases.
* Integrate Claude with client systems and data sources using the Claude API, Claude Agent SDK, MCP where appropriate, and conventional APIs and data services.
* Collaborate with our engineering and insurance teams to ship, test, and refine solutions.
* Develop evaluations and test the accuracy, reliability, and failure modes of Claude-powered workflows.
* Proactively identify opportunities to make carrier operations more efficient.
Who You Are
* You take ownership of outcomes and follow through without constant supervision.
* You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and learning unfamiliar technologies.
* You are curious, detail-oriented, and willing to investigate why something does not work.
* You communicate clearly and can explain technical ideas to non-technical stakeholders.
* You use AI development tools productively but independently verify their output.
* You want to build reliable solutions—not merely produce demonstrations.
Must-Haves
* Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD program in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field—or equivalent hands-on experience.
* Solid programming fundamentals, preferably in Python, and comfort working in the command line.
* Experience building at least one working software or LLM application beyond a tutorial or classroom exercise.
* Familiarity with Git, REST APIs, JSON, and basic application development.
* Genuine interest in building with LLMs and agentic AI systems.
* Willingness and ability to earn the Claude Certified Architect – Foundations certification within the accelerated timeline.
* Ability to independently complete the certification material while consistently participating in the supported cohort.
* Ability to commit approximately 40 hours per week if selected for the post-certification internship.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Nice-to-Haves
* Prior experience building with Claude or other LLMs, including prompt engineering, RAG, agents, structured outputs, or tool use.
* Familiarity with MCP, APIs, and integrating AI into real applications.
* Experience using an LLM through an API rather than solely through a chat interface.
* Exposure to P&C insurance or another regulated, document-heavy industry.
* Open-source contributions or a portfolio of AI, ML, or software projects.
* Experience with cloud services, Docker, databases, automated testing, or CI/CD.
How to Apply
